167        public static class LocData {
168                public CampaignTerrainAPI terrain;
169                public EntityLocation loc;
170                public EntityLocationType type;
171                public SectorEntityToken centerOn;
172                public LocationAPI system; // can be hyperspace when type is ORBITING_PARAM or EntityLocation is set
173                public boolean removeOnMissionOver;
174                
175                /**
176                 * At provided EntityLocation.
177                 */
178                public LocData(EntityLocation loc, LocationAPI system, boolean removeOnMissionOver) {
179                        this.loc = loc;
180                        this.removeOnMissionOver = removeOnMissionOver;
181                        this.system = system;
182                }
183                
184                /**
185                 * Generate an EntityLocation based on the type. centerOn is used if type is ORBITING_PARAM.
186                 */
187                public LocData(EntityLocationType type, SectorEntityToken centerOn, LocationAPI system,
188                                                                 boolean removeOnMissionOver) {
189                        this.type = type;
190                        this.centerOn = centerOn;
191                        this.system = system;
192                        this.removeOnMissionOver = removeOnMissionOver;
193                }
194                
195                /**
196                 * Set to a zero-radius orbit around centerOn.
197                 */
198                public LocData(SectorEntityToken centerOn, boolean removeOnMissionOver) {
199                        if (centerOn instanceof CampaignTerrainAPI) {
200                                this.centerOn = centerOn;
201                        } else {
202                                loc = new EntityLocation();
203                                loc.type = LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM;
204                                loc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(centerOn, 0f, 0f, 1000f);
205                        }
206                        system = centerOn.getContainingLocation();
207                        this.removeOnMissionOver = removeOnMissionOver;
208                }
209                
210                /**
211                 * At fixed coordinates, no orbit.
212                 */
213                public LocData(Vector2f loc, LocationAPI system, boolean removeOnMissionOver) {
214                        this.loc = new EntityLocation();
215                        this.loc.type = LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM;
216                        this.loc.location = loc;
217                        this.system = system;
218                        this.removeOnMissionOver = removeOnMissionOver;
219                }
220                
221                /**
222                 * At provided EntityLocation.
223                 */
224                public LocData(EntityLocation loc, LocationAPI system) {
225                        this(loc, system, true);
226                }
227                
228                /**
229                 * Generate an EntityLocation based on the type. centerOn is used if type is ORBITING_PARAM.
230                 */
231                public LocData(EntityLocationType type, SectorEntityToken centerOn, LocationAPI system) {
232                        this(type, centerOn, system, true);
233                }
234                
235                /**
236                 * Set to a zero-radius orbit around centerOn.
237                 */
238                public LocData(SectorEntityToken centerOn) {
239                        this(centerOn, true);
240                }
241                
242                /**
243                 * At fixed coordinates, no orbit.
244                 */
245                public LocData(Vector2f loc, LocationAPI system) {
246                        this(loc, system, true);
247                }
248                
249                public boolean updateLocIfNeeded(BaseHubMission mission, String entityId) {
250                        if (centerOn instanceof CampaignTerrainAPI) {
251                                CampaignTerrainAPI terrain = (CampaignTerrainAPI) centerOn;
252                                loc = mission.generateLocationInsideTerrain(terrain);
253                                if (loc == null) return false;
254                        } else if (type != null) {
255                                loc = mission.generateLocation(entityId, type, centerOn, system);
256                                if (loc == null) return false;
257                        }
258                        return true;
259                }
260                
261                public void placeEntity(SectorEntityToken entity) {
262                        //if (!updateLocIfNeeded(mission, entity.getCustomEntityType())) return false;
263                        
264                        if (loc.orbit != null) {
265                                entity.setOrbit(loc.orbit);
266                                loc.orbit.setEntity(entity);
267                        } else {
268                                entity.setOrbit(null);
269                                entity.getLocation().set(loc.location);
270                        }
271                        
272                        if (removeOnMissionOver) {
273                                entity.addTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER);
274                        }
275                }
276        }

356        public static class MarketDecivChecker implements ConditionChecker {
357                public MarketAPI market;
358                public MarketDecivChecker(MarketAPI market) {
359                        this.market = market;
360                }
361                public boolean conditionsMet() {
362                        return market.isPlanetConditionMarketOnly() ||
363                                   (market.getPrimaryEntity() != null && !market.getPrimaryEntity().isAlive());
364                }

391        public static class DaysElapsedChecker implements ConditionChecker {
392                public float days;
393                public StageData stage;
394                public BaseHubMission mission;
395                public DaysElapsedChecker(float days, StageData stage) {
396                        this.days = days;
397                        this.stage = stage;
398                }
399                
400                public DaysElapsedChecker(float days, BaseHubMission mission) {
401                        this.days = days;
402                        this.mission = mission;
403                }
404
405                public boolean conditionsMet() {
406                        if (mission != null) {
407                                return mission.elapsed >= days;
408                        }
409                        return stage.elapsed >= days;
410                }
411        }

419        public static class InRangeOfEntityChecker implements ConditionChecker {
420                public SectorEntityToken entity;
421                public float range;
422                public InRangeOfEntityChecker(SectorEntityToken entity, float range) {
423                        this.entity = entity;
424                        this.range = range;
425                }
426                public boolean conditionsMet() {
427                        return Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation() == entity.getContainingLocation() &&
428                                                        Misc.getDistance(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), entity) < range;
429                }
430        }

432        public static class InHyperRangeOfEntityChecker implements ConditionChecker {
433                public SectorEntityToken entity;
434                public float rangeLY;
435                public boolean requirePlayerInHyperspace;
436                public InHyperRangeOfEntityChecker(SectorEntityToken entity, float rangeLY, boolean requirePlayerInHyperspace) {
437                        this.entity = entity;
438                        this.rangeLY = rangeLY;
439                        this.requirePlayerInHyperspace = requirePlayerInHyperspace;
440                }
441                public boolean conditionsMet() {
442                        if (requirePlayerInHyperspace && !Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().isInHyperspace()) return false;
443                        return Misc.getDistanceLY(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), entity) < rangeLY;
444                }
445        }

485        public static class VariableSet implements Abortable {
486                public MemoryAPI memory;
487                public String key;
488                public boolean removeOnMissionOver;
489                public VariableSet(MemoryAPI memory, String key, boolean removeOnMissionOver) {
490                        this.memory = memory;
491                        this.key = key;
492                        this.removeOnMissionOver = removeOnMissionOver;
493                }
494
495                public void abort(HubMission mission, boolean missionOver) {
496                        if (!removeOnMissionOver && missionOver) return;
497                        memory.unset(key);
498                }
499        }

529        public static String REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER = "remove_on_mission_over";
530        public static class EntityAdded implements Abortable {
531                public SectorEntityToken entity;
532                public EntityAdded(SectorEntityToken entity) {
533                        this.entity = entity;
534                }
535
536                public void abort(HubMission mission, boolean missionOver) {
537                        if (missionOver) {
538                                if (!entity.hasTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER)) return;
539                                if (entity.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING)) return;
540                        }
541                        if (entity.getContainingLocation() != null) {
542                                entity.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(entity);
543                        }
544                }
545        }
546        
547        public static class PersonAdded implements Abortable {
548                public MarketAPI market;
549                public PersonAPI person;
550                public boolean wasOnlyAddedToCommDirectory;
551
552                public PersonAdded(MarketAPI market, PersonAPI person, boolean wasOnlyAddedToCommDirectory) {
553                        this.market = market;
554                        this.person = person;
555                        this.wasOnlyAddedToCommDirectory = wasOnlyAddedToCommDirectory;
556                }
557
558                public void abort(HubMission mission, boolean missionOver) {
559                        if (missionOver && !person.hasTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER)) return;
560                        
561                        if (mission instanceof BaseHubMission) {
562                                BaseHubMission bhm = (BaseHubMission) mission;
563                                if (Misc.setFlagWithReason(person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), 
564                                                "$requiredForMissions", bhm.getReason(), false, -1f)) {
565                                        return;
566                                }
567                        }
568                        
569                        if (!wasOnlyAddedToCommDirectory) {
570                                if (market != null) market.removePerson(person);
571                                Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().removePerson(person);
572                        }
573                        if (market != null) market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
574                }
575        }

675        public void setPersonIsPotentialContactOnSuccess(PersonAPI person, float probability) {
676                if (person == null) return;
677                if (potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess == null) {
678                        potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess = new ArrayList<PotentialContactData>();
679                }
680                for (PotentialContactData data : potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess) {
681                        if (data.contact == person) return;
682                }
683                PotentialContactData data = new PotentialContactData();
684                data.contact = person;
685                data.probability = probability;
686                potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess.add(data);
687        }

772        @Override
773        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
774                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
775                StageData stage = getData(currentStage);
776                if (stage != null) {
777                        stage.elapsed += days;
778                }
779                
780                //elapsed += days * 100f;
781                elapsed += days;
782
783                //if (timeLimit != null) timeLimit.days = 240;
784                if (timeLimit != null && timeLimit.days < elapsed &&
785                                (timeLimit.noLimitWhileInSystem == null || 
786                                                timeLimit.noLimitWhileInSystem != Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation())) {
787                        setCurrentStage(timeLimit.failStage, null, null);
788                        timeLimit = null;
789                        runTriggers();
790                }
791                
792                tracker.advance(days);
793                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
794                        checkStageChangesAndTriggers(null, null);
795                }
796        }

889        protected void addPotentialContacts(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
890                if (potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess != null) {

902                        }
903                        potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess = null;
904                }

908        @Override
909        public boolean callEvent(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
910                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
911                
912                if ("endFailure".equals(action)) {
913                        Object stage = null;
914                        if (!failStages.isEmpty()) {
915                                stage = failStages.get(0);
916                        }
917                        if (stage == null && !noPenaltyFailStages.isEmpty()) {
918                                stage = noPenaltyFailStages.get(0);
919                        }
920                        if (stage != null) {
921                                setCurrentStage(stage, dialog, memoryMap);
922                                runTriggers();
923                        }
924                        return true;
925                }
926                
927                if ("makeUnimportant".equals(action)) {
928                        SectorEntityToken target = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
929                        if (target != null) {
930                                makeUnimportant(target, (Enum) currentStage);
931                                if (target.getMarket() != null) {
932                                        makeUnimportant(target.getMarket(), (Enum) currentStage);
933                                }
934                                if (target.getActivePerson() != null) {
935                                        makeUnimportant(target.getActivePerson(), (Enum) currentStage);
936                                }
937                        }
938                        return true;
939                }
940                
941                if ("showMap".equals(action)) {
942                        SectorEntityToken mapLoc = getMapLocation(null, startingStage);
943                        if (mapLoc != null) {
944                                String title = params.get(1).getStringWithTokenReplacement(ruleId, dialog, memoryMap);
945                                String text = "";
946                                Set<String> tags = getIntelTags(null);
947                                tags.remove(Tags.INTEL_ACCEPTED);
948                                String icon = getIcon();
949                                
950                                Color color = getFactionForUIColors().getBaseUIColor();
951                                //String factionId = getFactionForUIColors().getId();
952                                if (mapLoc != null && mapLoc.getFaction() != null && !mapLoc.getFaction().isNeutralFaction()) {
953                                        color = mapLoc.getFaction().getBaseUIColor();
954                                        //factionId = mapLoc.getFaction().getId();
955                                } else if (mapLoc instanceof PlanetAPI) {
956                                        PlanetAPI planet = (PlanetAPI) mapLoc;
957                                        if (planet.getStarSystem() != null && planet.getFaction().isNeutralFaction()) {
958                                                StarSystemAPI system = planet.getStarSystem();
959                                                if (system.getStar() == planet || system.getCenter() == planet) {
960                                                        if (planet.getMarket() != null) {
961                                                                color = planet.getMarket().getTextColorForFactionOrPlanet();
962                                                        } else {
963                                                                color = Misc.setAlpha(planet.getSpec().getIconColor(), 255);
964                                                                color = Misc.setBrightness(color, 235);
965                                                        }
966                                                } else {
967                                                        color = Misc.setAlpha(planet.getSpec().getIconColor(), 255);
968                                                        color = Misc.setBrightness(color, 235);
969                                                }
970                                        }
971                                }
972                                if (mapMarkerNameColor != null) {
973                                        color = mapMarkerNameColor;
974                                }
975                                
976                                dialog.getVisualPanel().showMapMarker(mapLoc, 
977                                                title, color, 
978                                                true, icon, text, tags);
979                        }
980                        return true;
981                }
982                
983                if ("hideMap".equals(action)) {
984                        dialog.getVisualPanel().removeMapMarkerFromPersonInfo();
985                        return true;
986                }
987                
988//              if (action.equals("endSuccess")) {
989//                      doNotEndMission = true;
990//                      checkStageChangesAndTriggers();
991//                      doNotEndMission = false;
992//                      endSuccess(dialog, memoryMap);
993//              } else if (action.equals("endFailure")) {
994//                      doNotEndMission = true;
995//                      checkStageChangesAndTriggers();
996//                      doNotEndMission = false;
997//                      endFailure(dialog, memoryMap);
998//              } else
999                if (action.equals("updateStage")) {
1000                        checkStageChangesAndTriggers(dialog, memoryMap);
1001                } else if (action.equals("updateData")) {
1002                        checkStageChangesAndTriggers(dialog, memoryMap);
1003                        updateInteractionData(dialog, memoryMap);
1004                } else if (action.equals("addContacts")) {
1005                        addPotentialContacts(dialog);
1006                } else if (action.equals("repSuccess")) {
1007                        adjustRep(dialog.getTextPanel(), null, RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS);
1008                } else if (action.equals("repFailure")) {
1009                        adjustRep(dialog.getTextPanel(), null, RepActions.MISSION_FAILURE);
1010                } else {
1011                        if (!callAction(action, ruleId, dialog, params, memoryMap)) {
1012                                throw new RuntimeException("Unhandled action [" + action + "] in " + getClass().getSimpleName() + 
1013                                                                                   " for rule [" + ruleId + "], params:[" + params + "]");
1014                        }
1015                }
1016                return true;
1017        }

1137        public void checkStageChangesAndTriggers(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
1138                if (isEnding()) return;
1139                boolean changed = false;
1140                do {
1141                        changed = false;
1142                        for (StageConnection conn : connections) {
1143                                if (conn.from != currentStage && conn.from != null) continue;
1144                                if (conn.to == currentStage) continue;
1145                                
1146                                if (conn.checker.conditionsMet()) {
1147                                        setCurrentStage(conn.to, dialog, memoryMap);
1148                                        changed = true;
1149                                        
1150                                        if (stageTransitionsRepeatable == null || !stageTransitionsRepeatable) {
1151                                                connections.remove(conn);
1152                                        }
1153                                        
1154                                        break;
1155                                }
1156                        }
1157                        //runTriggers();
1158                } while (changed);
1159                
1160                runTriggers();
1161        }
1162        
1163        protected void runTriggers() {
1164                Iterator<MissionTrigger> iter = triggers.iterator();
1165                while (iter.hasNext()) {
1166                        MissionTrigger trigger = iter.next();
1167                        if (!trigger.getStages().contains(currentStage)) continue;
1168                        if (trigger.getCondition().conditionsMet()) {
1169                                TriggerActionContext context = new TriggerActionContext(this);
1170                                for (TriggerAction curr : trigger.getActions()) {
1171                                        curr.doAction(context);
1172                                }
1173                                iter.remove();
1174                        }
1175                }
1176        }

1178        public List<CampaignFleetAPI> runStageTriggersReturnFleets(Object stage) {
1179                List<CampaignFleetAPI> result = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
1180                Iterator<MissionTrigger> iter = triggers.iterator();
1181                while (iter.hasNext()) {
1182                        MissionTrigger trigger = iter.next();
1183                        if (!trigger.getStages().contains(stage)) continue;
1184                        if (trigger.getCondition().conditionsMet()) {
1185                                TriggerActionContext context = new TriggerActionContext(this);
1186                                for (TriggerAction curr : trigger.getActions()) {
1187                                        curr.doAction(context);
1188                                }
1189                                iter.remove();
1190                                result.addAll(context.allFleets);
1191                        }
1192                }
1193                return result;
1194        }

1196        protected transient boolean doNotEndMission = false;
1197        public void setCurrentStage(Object next, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
1198                if (currentStage == next) {
1199                        return;
1200                }
1201                
1202                if (currentStage != null) {
1203                        StageData data = getData(currentStage);
1204                        for (ImportanceData curr : data.important) {
1205                                Misc.makeUnimportant(curr.memory, getReason());
1206                                removeImportanceChanges(curr.memory);
1207                                
1208                                if (curr.flag != null) {
1209                                        curr.memory.unset(curr.flag);
1210                                        removeMemoryFlagChanges(curr.memory, curr.flag);
1211                                }
1212                        }
1213                }
1214                
1215                currentStage = next;
1216                if (timeLimit != null && timeLimit.endLimitStages != null && 
1217                                timeLimit.endLimitStages.contains(currentStage)) {
1218                        timeLimit = null;
1219                }
1220                
1221                StageData data = getData(currentStage);
1222                data.elapsed = 0;
1223                for (ImportanceData curr : data.important) {
1224                        //if (curr.market != null) curr.memory = curr.market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
1225                        
1226                        Misc.makeImportant(curr.memory, getReason());
1227                        changes.add(new MadeImportant(curr.memory, getReason()));
1228                        if (curr.flag != null) {
1229                                curr.memory.set(curr.flag, true);
1230                                changes.add(new VariableSet(curr.memory, curr.flag, true));
1231                        }
1232                }
1233                
1234                for (FlagData fd : flags) {
1235                        if (fd.stages.contains(currentStage)) {
1236                                removeMemoryFlagChanges(fd.memory, fd.flag);
1237                                if (fd.value == null) {
1238                                        fd.memory.set(fd.flag, true);
1239                                } else {
1240                                        fd.memory.set(fd.flag, fd.value);
1241                                }
1242                                changes.add(new VariableSet(fd.memory, fd.flag, true));
1243                        } else {
1244                                fd.memory.unset(fd.flag);
1245                                removeMemoryFlagChanges(fd.memory, fd.flag);
1246                        }
1247                                
1248                }
1249
1250                
1251                if (!doNotEndMission) {
1252                        if (successStages.contains(currentStage)) {
1253                                endSuccess(dialog, memoryMap);
1254                        } else if (failStages.contains(currentStage)) {
1255                                endFailure(dialog, memoryMap);
1256                        } else if (currentStage != null && currentStage == abandonStage) {
1257                                endAbandon();
1258                        } else if (shouldSendUpdateForStage(currentStage)) {
1259                                sendUpdateForNextStep(NEXT_STEP_UPDATE, dialog == null ? null : dialog.getTextPanel());
1260                        }
1261                }
1262                
1263                runTriggers();
1264        }

1266        protected void endSuccess(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
1267                setImportant(false);
1268                
1269                result = new HubMissionResult();
1270                result.success = true;
1271                
1272                TextPanelAPI textPanel = null;
1273                if (dialog != null) textPanel = dialog.getTextPanel();
1274                
1275                int xp = getXPReward();
1276                if (xp > 0) { 
1277                        Global.getSector().getPlayerStats().addXP(xp, textPanel);
1278                }
1279                
1280                int reward = getCreditsReward();
1281                if (reward > 0) {
1282                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().add(reward);
1283                }
1284                
1285                if (textPanel != null && reward > 0) {
1286                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsGainText(reward, dialog.getTextPanel());
1287                }
1288                
1289                
1290                result.reward = reward;
1291                result.xp = xp;
1292                
1293                adjustRep(textPanel, result, RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS);
1294
1295                
1296                endSuccessImpl(dialog, memoryMap);
1297                
1298                if (cargoOnSuccess != null) {
1299                        cargoOnSuccess.sort();
1300                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargoOnSuccess.getStacksCopy()) {
1301                                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().addItems(stack.getType(), stack.getData(), stack.getSize());
1302                                if (textPanel != null) { 
1303                                        AddRemoveCommodity.addStackGainText(stack, textPanel);
1304                                }
1305                        }
1306                        cargoOnSuccess.clear();
1307                }
1308                
1309                endAfterDelay();
1310                
1311//              if (textPanel == null) { // if in dialog, already printed stuff to the text panel
1312//                      sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(result, false);
1313//              }
1314                sendUpdateForNextStep(END_MISSION_UPDATE, dialog == null ? null : dialog.getTextPanel());
1315                
1316                if (creator != null) creator.incrCompleted();
1317                
1318                
1319                if (potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess != null) {
1320                        if (doNotAutoAddPotentialContactsOnSuccess == null || !doNotAutoAddPotentialContactsOnSuccess) {
1321                                for (PotentialContactData curr : potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess) {
1322                                        PersonAPI p = curr.contact;
1323                                        MarketAPI m = curr.contact.getMarket();
1324                                        if (m == null) m = getPerson().getMarket();
1325                                        if (curr.probability < 0) {
1326                                                ContactIntel.addPotentialContact(p, m, dialog != null ? dialog.getTextPanel() : null);
1327                                        } else {
1328                                                ContactIntel.addPotentialContact(curr.probability, p, m, dialog != null ? dialog.getTextPanel() : null);
1329                                        }
1330                                }
1331                                potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess = null;
1332                                doNotAutoAddPotentialContactsOnSuccess = null;
1333                        }
1334                }
1335                
1336                abort();
1337                
1338                if (completedKey != null) {
1339                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(completedKey, true);
1340                }
1341        }

1393        protected Boolean adjustedRep;
1394        protected void adjustRep(TextPanelAPI textPanel, HubMissionResult result, RepActions action) {
1395                if (adjustedRep != null) return;
1396                adjustedRep = true;
1397                
1398                MissionCompletionRep completionRepPerson = new MissionCompletionRep(
1399                                getRepRewardSuccessPerson(), getRewardLimitPerson(),
1400                                -getRepPenaltyFailurePerson(), getPenaltyLimitPerson());
1401                MissionCompletionRep completionRepFaction = new MissionCompletionRep(
1402                                getRepRewardSuccessFaction(), getRewardLimitFaction(),
1403                                -getRepPenaltyFailureFaction(), getPenaltyLimitFaction());
1404
1405                boolean withMessage = textPanel != null;
1406                
1407                boolean adjustPersonRep = (action == RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS && completionRepPerson.successDelta != 0) ||
1408                                (action == RepActions.MISSION_FAILURE && completionRepPerson.failureDelta != 0);
1409                if (adjustPersonRep && getPerson() != null) {
1410                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
1411                                        new RepActionEnvelope(action, completionRepPerson,
1412                                                        textPanel, true, withMessage), 
1413                                                        getPerson());
1414                        if (result != null) result.repPerson = rep;
1415                        completionRepPerson.successDelta = 0;
1416                }
1417
1418                boolean adjustFactionRep = (action == RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS && completionRepFaction.successDelta != 0) ||
1419                                (action == RepActions.MISSION_FAILURE && completionRepFaction.failureDelta != 0);
1420                if (adjustFactionRep && getPerson() != null) {
1421                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
1422                                        new RepActionEnvelope(action, completionRepFaction,
1423                                                        textPanel, true, withMessage), 
1424                                                        getPerson().getFaction().getId());
1425                        if (result != null) result.repFaction = rep;
1426                        completionRepFaction.successDelta = 0f;
1427                }
1428        }

1605        public void setFlag(MemoryAPI memory, String flag, Object value, boolean permanent, Object ... stages) {
1606                if (stages != null && stages.length > 0) {
1607                        FlagData fd = new FlagData();
1608                        fd.memory = memory;
1609                        fd.flag = flag;
1610                        fd.value = value;
1611                        fd.stages.addAll(Arrays.asList(stages));
1612                        flags.add(fd);
1613                        if (fd.stages.contains(currentStage)) {
1614                                removeMemoryFlagChanges(fd.memory, fd.flag);
1615                                if (fd.value == null) {
1616                                        fd.memory.set(fd.flag, true);
1617                                } else {
1618                                        fd.memory.set(fd.flag, fd.value);
1619                                }
1620                                changes.add(new VariableSet(fd.memory, fd.flag, true));
1621                        }
1622                } else {
1623                        if (value == null) {
1624                                memory.set(flag, true);
1625                        } else {
1626                                memory.set(flag, value);
1627                        }
1628                        changes.add(new VariableSet(memory, flag, !permanent));
1629                }
1630        }

1730        public void makeImportant(MemoryAPI memory, String flag, MapLocationType type, Object personOrEntityOrMarket, Enum ... stages) {
1731                boolean inCurrentStage = false;
1732                if (stages != null) {
1733                        for (Object id : stages) {
1734                                if (currentStage != null && id == currentStage) inCurrentStage = true;
1735                                ImportanceData data = new ImportanceData();
1736                                data.memory = memory;
1737                                data.flag = flag;
1738                                data.locType = type;
1739                                if (personOrEntityOrMarket instanceof PersonAPI) {
1740                                        data.person = (PersonAPI) personOrEntityOrMarket;
1741                                } else if (personOrEntityOrMarket instanceof SectorEntityToken) {
1742                                        data.entity = (SectorEntityToken) personOrEntityOrMarket;
1743                                } else if (personOrEntityOrMarket instanceof MarketAPI) {
1744                                        data.market = (MarketAPI) personOrEntityOrMarket;
1745                                }
1746                                getData(id).important.add(data);
1747                        }
1748                } else {
1749                        inCurrentStage = true;
1750                }
1751                
1752                if (inCurrentStage) {
1753                        Misc.makeImportant(memory, getReason());
1754                        if (stages != null) {
1755                                changes.add(new MadeImportant(memory, getReason()));
1756                        }
1757                        if (flag != null) {
1758                                memory.set(flag, true);
1759                                if (stages != null) {
1760                                        changes.add(new VariableSet(memory, flag, true));
1761                                }
1762                        }
1763                }
1764        }

1793        public void makeUnimportant(MemoryAPI memory, Object personOrEntityOrMarket, Enum ... stages) {
1794                List<StageData> list = new ArrayList<BaseHubMission.StageData>();
1795                if (stages != null) {
1796                        for (Object id : stages) {
1797                                StageData stageData = getData(id);
1798                                list.add(stageData);
1799                        }
1800                } else {
1801                        list.addAll(this.stages.values());
1802                }
1803                
1804                for (StageData stageData : list) {
1805                        Iterator<ImportanceData> iter = stageData.important.iterator();
1806                        while (iter.hasNext()) {
1807                                ImportanceData data = iter.next();
1808                                if (data.memory == memory || 
1809                                                data.person == personOrEntityOrMarket ||
1810                                                data.entity == personOrEntityOrMarket ||
1811                                                data.market == personOrEntityOrMarket) {
1812                                        iter.remove();
1813                                }
1814                        }
1815                }
1816                Misc.makeUnimportant(memory, getReason());
1817        }

1841        public int genRoundNumber(int min, int max) {
1842                int result = min + genRandom.nextInt(max - min + 1);
1843                return getRoundNumber(result);
1844        }
1845                
1846        public static int getRoundNumber(float num) {
1847                int num2 = (int) num;
1848                for (int i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
1849                        int threshold = (int) Math.pow(10, i);
1850                        int base = threshold / 10;
1851                        if (num2 > threshold) {
1852                                num2 = num2 / base * base;
1853                        }
1854                }
1855                return (int) num2;
1856        }

1860        public void setCreditReward(int min, int max, boolean withMult) {
1861                int reward = min + genRandom.nextInt(max - min + 1);
1862                if (withMult) {
1863                        reward = getRoundNumber(reward * rewardMult);
1864                }
1865                reward = reward / 1000 * 1000;
1866                if (reward > 100000) {
1867                        reward = reward / 10000 * 10000;
1868                }
1869                setCreditReward(reward);
1870        }

2063        public void makePrimaryObjective(Object personOrMarketOrEntity) {
2064                StageData stage = getData(currentStage);
2065                ImportanceData data = null;
2066                for (ImportanceData curr : stage.important) {
2067                        if (curr.locType == null) continue;
2068                        if (curr.entity == personOrMarketOrEntity || 
2069                                        curr.market == personOrMarketOrEntity ||
2070                                        curr.person == personOrMarketOrEntity) {
2071                                data = curr;
2072                                break;
2073                        }
2074                }
2075                if (data != null) {
2076                        stage.important.remove(data);
2077                        stage.important.add(0, data);
2078                }
2079        }

2081        public SectorEntityToken getMapLocation(SectorMapAPI map, Object currentStage) {
2082                if (currentStage == null) {
2083                        currentStage = startingStage;
2084                }
2085                StageData stage = getData(currentStage);
2086                ImportanceData data = null;
2087                for (ImportanceData curr : stage.important) {
2088                        if (curr.locType == null) continue;
2089                        if (curr.entity != null && !curr.entity.isAlive()) continue;
2090                        data = curr;
2091                        break;
2092                }
2093                if (data == null || data.locType == null) return null;
2094                
2095                SectorEntityToken entity = data.entity;
2096                if (entity == null && data.person != null && data.person.getMarket() != null) {
2097                        entity = data.person.getMarket().getPrimaryEntity();
2098                }
2099                if (entity == null && data.market!= null) {
2100                        entity = data.market.getPrimaryEntity();
2101                }
2102                if (entity == null) return null;
2103                
2104                if (data.locType == MapLocationType.NORMAL) {
2105                        if ((entity.isDiscoverable() || 
2106                                        (entity instanceof CampaignFleetAPI && !((CampaignFleetAPI)entity).isVisibleToPlayerFleet())) && entity.getStarSystem() != null) {
2107                                return entity.getStarSystem().getCenter();
2108                        }
2109                        return entity;
2110                } else if (data.locType == MapLocationType.CONSTELLATION) {
2111                        Constellation c = entity.getConstellation();
2112                        SectorEntityToken result = null;
2113                        if (c != null && map != null) {
2114                                result = map.getConstellationLabelEntity(c);
2115                        }
2116                        if (result == null) result = entity;
2117                        return result;
2118                }
2119                
2120                return entity;
2121        }

2249        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
2250                
2251                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
2252                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
2253                float pad = 3f;
2254                float opad = 10f;
2255                
2256                float initPad = pad;
2257                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
2258                
2259                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
2260                
2261                bullet(info);
2262                
2263                addBulletPointsPre(info, tc, initPad, mode);
2264                
2265                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
2266                
2267                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
2268                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
2269                
2270                if (isUpdate) {
2271                        // Possible updates: failed, completed, next step
2272                        if (getListInfoParam() == NEXT_STEP_UPDATE) {
2273                                if (addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad)) {
2274                                        initPad = 0f;
2275                                }
2276                        } else if (isFailed()) {
2277                                addResultBulletsAssumingAlreadyIndented(info, mode);
2278                                addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad);
2279                        } else if (isSucceeded()) {
2280                                addResultBulletsAssumingAlreadyIndented(info, mode);
2281                                addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad);
2282                        } else {
2283                                addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad);
2284                        }
2285                } else {
2286                        // either in small description, or in tooltip/intel list
2287                        if (result != null) {
2288                                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
2289                                        addResultBulletsAssumingAlreadyIndented(info, mode);
2290                                }
2291                        } else {
2292                                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
2293//                                      if (addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad)) {
2294//                                              initPad = 0f;
2295//                                      }
2296                                        
2297                                        int reward = getCreditsReward();
2298                                        if (reward > 0) {
2299                                                info.addPara("%s reward", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(reward));
2300                                                initPad = 0f;
2301                                        }
2302                                        if (timeLimit != null) {
2303                                                addDays(info, getToCompleteText(), timeLimit.days - elapsed, tc, initPad);
2304                                                initPad = 0f;
2305                                        }       
2306                                } else {
2307                                        if (addNextStepText(info, tc, initPad)) {
2308                                                initPad = 0f;
2309                                        }
2310//                                      int reward = getCreditsReward();
2311//                                      if (reward > 0) {
2312//                                              info.addPara("%s reward", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(reward));
2313//                                              initPad = 0f;
2314//                                      }
2315                                        if (timeLimit != null) {
2316                                                addDays(info, getToCompleteText(), timeLimit.days - elapsed, tc, initPad);
2317                                                initPad = 0f;
2318                                        }
2319                                }
2320                        }
2321                }
2322                
2323                addBulletPointsPost(info, tc, initPad, mode);
2324                
2325                unindent(info);
2326                
2327        }

2437        @Override
2438        public void createConfirmationPrompt(Object buttonId, TooltipMakerAPI prompt) {
2439                FactionAPI faction = getFactionForUIColors();
2440                
2441                if (buttonId == BUTTON_ABANDON) {
2442                        boolean loseRepFaction = getRepPenaltyFailureFaction() > 0; 
2443                        boolean loseRepPerson = getRepPenaltyFailurePerson() > 0;
2444                        if (!loseRepFaction && !loseRepPerson) {
2445                                prompt.addPara("You can abandon this " + getMissionTypeNoun() + " without a penalty.", 0f);
2446                        } else if (canAbandonWithoutPenalty()) {
2447                                prompt.addPara("It's been less than a day, and you can still abandon this " + getMissionTypeNoun() + " without a penalty.", 0f);
2448                        } else {
2449                                if (loseRepFaction && !loseRepPerson) {
2450                                        prompt.addPara("You can abandon this " + getMissionTypeNoun() + ", but will suffer " +
2451                                                        "a reputation penalty with " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ".", 0f,
2452                                                        Misc.getTextColor(), faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
2453                                } else if (!loseRepFaction && loseRepPerson) {
2454                                        prompt.addPara("You can abandon this " + getMissionTypeNoun() + ", but will suffer " +
2455                                                        "a reputation penalty with " + getPerson().getNameString() + ".", 
2456                                                        Misc.getTextColor(), 0f);
2457                                } else {
2458                                        prompt.addPara("You can abandon this " + getMissionTypeNoun() + ", but will suffer " +
2459                                                        "a reputation penalty with both " + getPerson().getNameString() + " and " + 
2460                                                        faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ".", 0f,
2461                                                        Misc.getTextColor(), faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
2462                                }
2463                        }
2464                } else {
2465                        super.createConfirmationPrompt(buttonId, prompt);
2466                }
2467        }

2529                if (item.startsWith("an ")) {
2530                        return item.replaceFirst("an ", "");
2531                }
2532                if (item.startsWith("the ")) {
2533                        return item.replaceFirst("the ", "");
2534                }
2535                return item;
2536        }

2673        public EntityLocation generateLocation(String entityId, EntityLocationType locType, SectorEntityToken param, LocationAPI system) {
2674                EntityLocation loc = null;
2675                float gap = 100f;
2676                if (system instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
2677                        if (locType == EntityLocationType.HIDDEN) {
2678                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickHiddenLocation(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, null);
2679                        } else if (locType == EntityLocationType.HIDDEN_NOT_NEAR_STAR) {
2680                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickHiddenLocationNotNearStar(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, null);
2681                        } else if (locType == EntityLocationType.ORBITING_PLANET) {
2682                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickCommonLocation(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, false, null);
2683                        } else if (locType == EntityLocationType.ORBITING_PLANET_OR_STAR) {
2684                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickCommonLocation(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, true, null);
2685                        } else if (locType == EntityLocationType.UNCOMMON) {
2686                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickUncommonLocation(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, null);
2687                        } else if (locType == EntityLocationType.ANY) {
2688                                loc = BaseThemeGenerator.pickAnyLocation(genRandom, (StarSystemAPI)system, gap, null);
2689                        }
2690                }
2691                
2692                if (locType == EntityLocationType.ORBITING_PARAM) {
2693                        loc = BaseThemeGenerator.createLocationAtRandomGap(genRandom, param, gap);
2694                        if (loc == null) {
2695                                float radius = 75f;
2696                                if (entityId != null) {
2697                                        CustomEntitySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getCustomEntitySpec(entityId);
2698                                        radius = spec.getDefaultRadius();
2699                                }
2700                                loc = new EntityLocation();
2701                                loc.type = LocationType.PLANET_ORBIT;
2702                                loc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbitWithSpin(param, 
2703                                                                        genRandom.nextFloat() * 360f, param.getRadius() + radius + 100f, 
2704                                                                        20f + 20f * genRandom.nextFloat(), genRandom.nextFloat() * 10f + 1f);
2705                        }
2706                }
2707                
2708                if (loc == null) {
2709                        if (system instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
2710                                loc = new EntityLocation();
2711                                loc.type = LocationType.STAR_ORBIT;
2712                                loc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbitWithSpin(((StarSystemAPI)system).getCenter(), 
2713                                                                        genRandom.nextFloat() * 360f, 5000f, 
2714                                                                        20f + 20f * genRandom.nextFloat(), genRandom.nextFloat() * 10f + 1f);
2715                        } else {
2716                                loc = new EntityLocation();
2717                                loc.type = LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM;
2718                                loc.location = new Vector2f();
2719                        }
2720                }
2721                return loc;
2722        }

2788        public void spawnShipGraveyard(String factionId, int minShips, int maxShips, LocData data) {
2789                SectorEntityToken focus = spawnEntityToken(data);
2790                
2791                int numShips = minShips + genRandom.nextInt(maxShips - minShips + 1);
2792                
2793                WeightedRandomPicker<Float> bands = new WeightedRandomPicker<Float>(genRandom);
2794                for (int i = 0; i < numShips + 5; i++) {
2795                        bands.add(new Float(120f + i * 20f), (i + 1f) * (i + 1f));
2796                }
2797                
2798                for (int i = 0; i < numShips; i++) {
2799                        float r = bands.pickAndRemove();
2800                        
2801                        EntityLocation loc = new EntityLocation();
2802                        loc.type = LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM;
2803                        float orbitDays = r / (5f + genRandom.nextFloat() * 10f);
2804                        loc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(focus, genRandom.nextFloat() * 360f, r, orbitDays);
2805                        
2806                        LocData curr = new LocData(loc, data.system, data.removeOnMissionOver);
2807                        
2808                        spawnDerelict(factionId, null, curr);
2809                }
2810        }

2845        protected PersonAPI findOrCreatePerson(String factionId, MarketAPI market, boolean cleanUpOnMissionOverIfWasNewPerson, String defaultRank, String ... posts) {
2846                String reason = getReason();
2847                PersonAPI person = null;
2848                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
2849                
2850                
2851                FactionAPI faction = null;
2852                if (market != null) faction = market.getFaction();
2853                if (factionId != null) {
2854                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
2855                }
2856                
2857                person = ip.getPerson(genRandom, faction, market, reason, defaultRank, posts).getPerson();
2858                
2859                boolean createdNewPerson = !ip.isLastGetPersonResultWasExistingPerson();
2860                
2861                if (person != null && !createdNewPerson &&
2862                                Misc.flagHasReason(person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), "$requiredForMissions", getReason())) {
2863                        // this can happen if the person was already created *for this exact type of mission*
2864                        // so, don't use them - they're already the target of the same mission and mission
2865                        // creation would fail later anyway.
2866                        // this also causes - when this mission is aborted - for that person to be removed from
2867                        // their market in this failed mission's abort(), because it's requiredForMissions with the
2868                        // same id as this.
2869                        person = null;
2870                }
2871                
2872                if (person == null) {
2873                        person = faction.createRandomPerson(genRandom);
2874                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> postPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
2875                        for (String post : posts) {
2876                                postPicker.add(post);
2877                        }
2878                        person.setPostId(postPicker.pick());
2879                        person.setRankId(defaultRank);
2880                        person.setMarket(market);
2881                        if (market != null) market.addPerson(person);
2882                        ip.addPerson(person);
2883                        ip.getData(person).getLocation().setMarket(market);
2884                }
2885                
2886                if (isBarEvent() || createdNewPerson) {
2887                        ip.excludeFromGetPerson(person);
2888                }
2889                
2890                boolean addedToComms = false;
2891                if (market != null && market.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person) == null) {
2892                        market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
2893                        addedToComms = true;
2894                }
2895                
2896                boolean willBeRemoved = false;
2897                if (createdNewPerson || addedToComms) {
2898                        if (cleanUpOnMissionOverIfWasNewPerson) {
2899                                person.addTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER);
2900                        }
2901                        PersonAdded added = new PersonAdded(market, person, !createdNewPerson); 
2902                        changes.add(added);
2903                        willBeRemoved = true;
2904                }
2905                
2906                makePersonRequired(person);
2907                if (!willBeRemoved && person.hasTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER)) {
2908                        PersonAdded added = new PersonAdded(market, person, false);
2909                        changes.add(added);
2910                }
2911                
2912                person.setMarket(market);
2913                
2914                return person;
2915        }
2916        
2917        public void makePersonRequired(PersonAPI person) {
2918                PersonMadeRequired req = new PersonMadeRequired(person);
2919                // always add at the start so the flag is unset and the person can be deleted by the PersonAdded change
2920                changes.add(0, req);
2921                Misc.setFlagWithReason(person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), "$requiredForMissions", getReason(), true, -1f);
2922        }
2923        
2924        protected void ensurePersonIsInCommDirectory(MarketAPI market, PersonAPI person) {
2925                boolean addedToComms = false;
2926                if (market != null && market.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person) == null) {
2927                        market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
2928                        addedToComms = true;
2929                }
2930                
2931                if (addedToComms) {
2932                        PersonAdded added = new PersonAdded(market, person, true); 
2933                        changes.add(added);
2934                }
2935        }

2980        public void findOrCreateGiver(MarketAPI market, boolean addToCommDirectory, boolean cleanUpOnMissionOverIfWasNewPerson) {
2981                String factionId = giverFactionId;
2982                if (factionId == null) factionId = market.getFactionId();
2983                PersonAPI person = findOrCreatePerson(factionId, market, cleanUpOnMissionOverIfWasNewPerson, giverRank, giverPost);

2985                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
2986                boolean createdNewPerson = !ip.isLastGetPersonResultWasExistingPerson();
2987                
2988                if (person != null) {
2989                        if (createdNewPerson) {
2990                                person.setRankId(giverRank);
2991                                person.setPostId(giverPost);
2992                                person.setImportanceAndVoice(giverImportance, genRandom);
2993                                if (giverVoice != null) {
2994                                        person.setVoice(giverVoice);
2995                                }
2996                                if (giverPortrait != null) {
2997                                        person.setPortraitSprite(giverPortrait);
2998                                }
2999                        }
3000                        // add giver tags regardless of whether person was created or already existed
3001                        if (giverTags != null) {
3002                                for (String tag : giverTags){ 
3003                                        person.addTag(tag);
3004                                }
3005                        }
3006                        if (createdNewPerson && !addToCommDirectory) {
3007                                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
3008                        }
3009                        person.setMarket(market);
3010                        personOverride = person;
3011                }
3012        }

3072                
3073                ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
3074                
3075                market.addPerson(person);
3076                ip.addPerson(person);
3077                ip.getData(person).getLocation().setMarket(market);
3078        
3079                if (addToCommDirectory) {
3080                        market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
3081                }
3082                if (removeOnMissionOver) {
3083                        person.addTag(REMOVE_ON_MISSION_OVER);
3084                }
3085                PersonAdded added = new PersonAdded(market, person, false); 
3086                changes.add(added);
3087                
3088                makePersonRequired(person);
3089                
3090                personOverride = person;
3091                
3092                genMissionRewardMultAndQuality();
3093        }

3096        public void genMissionRewardMultAndQuality() {
3097                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
3098                if (person == null) return;
3099                float rel = person.getRelToPlayer().getRel();
3100                
3101                if (rel > 0) {
3102                        rewardMult = 1f + rel * (Global.getSettings().getFloat("missionMaxRewardMultFromRel") - 1f);
3103                } else if (rel < 0) {
3104                        rewardMult = 1f + rel * (1f - Global.getSettings().getFloat("missionMinRewardMultFromRel"));
3105                }
3106                
3107                float importance = person.getImportance().getValue();
3108
3109                float min = getMinQuality(); 
3110                float maxRelBonus = Global.getSettings().getFloat("missionMaxPossibleQualityAboveImportance"); 
3111                
3112                quality = Math.min(Math.max(0, rel), importance);
3113                if (rel > importance && importance < 1f) {
3114                        quality += (rel - importance) / (1f - importance) * maxRelBonus;
3115                }
3116                
3117                if (person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(BaseMissionHub.MISSION_QUALITY_BONUS)) {
3118                        quality += person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(BaseMissionHub.MISSION_QUALITY_BONUS);
3119                }
3120                
3121                if (quality < min) quality = min;
3122                if (quality > 1f) quality = 1f;
3123        }

3250        public EntityLocation generateLocationInsideTerrain(CampaignTerrainAPI terrain) {
3251                //LocationAPI location = terrain.getContainingLocation();
3252                
3253                CampaignTerrainPlugin plugin = terrain.getPlugin();
3254                boolean found = false;
3255                float orbitAngle = 0f;
3256                float orbitRadius = 0f;
3257                float orbitPeriod = 0f;
3258                SectorEntityToken orbitFocus = terrain;
3259                Vector2f forceLoc = null;
3260                
3261                if (plugin instanceof BaseTiledTerrain) {
3262                        BaseTiledTerrain tiles = (BaseTiledTerrain) plugin;
3263                        
3264                        float maxRadius = plugin.getRenderRange();
3265                        if (maxRadius < 100f) maxRadius = 100f;
3266                        WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Integer, Integer>> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Integer,Integer>>(genRandom);
3267                        WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Integer, Integer>> pickerPref = new WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Integer,Integer>>(genRandom);
3268                        
3269                        for (int i = 0; i < tiles.getTiles().length; i++) {
3270                                for (int j = 0; j < tiles.getTiles()[0].length; j++) {
3271                                        if (tiles.getTiles()[i][j] >= 0) {
3272                                                float [] f = tiles.getTileCenter(i, j);
3273                                                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(f[0], f[1]);
3274                                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(terrain.getLocation(), loc);
3275                                                float weight = (float) Math.pow(dist / maxRadius, 3);
3276                                                if (dist < 16000) {
3277                                                        pickerPref.add(new Pair<Integer, Integer>(i, j), weight);
3278                                                } else if (pickerPref.isEmpty()) {
3279                                                        picker.add(new Pair<Integer, Integer>(i, j), weight);
3280                                                }
3281                                        }
3282                                }
3283                        }
3284                        
3285                        Pair<Integer, Integer> pick = pickerPref.pick();
3286                        if (pick == null) pick = picker.pick();
3287                        
3288                        if (pick != null) {
3289                                float [] f = tiles.getTileCenter(pick.one, pick.two);
3290                                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(f[0], f[1]);
3291                                
3292                                if (terrain.getOrbit() == null || terrain.getCircularOrbitRadius() <= 0 || terrain.getOrbitFocus() == null) {
3293                                        forceLoc = loc;
3294                                } else {
3295                                        orbitFocus = terrain.getOrbitFocus();
3296                                        orbitAngle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(orbitFocus.getLocation(), loc);
3297                                        orbitRadius = Misc.getDistance(orbitFocus.getLocation(), loc);
3298                                        orbitPeriod = terrain.getCircularOrbitPeriod();
3299                                }
3300                                found = true;
3301                        }
3302
3303                } else if (plugin instanceof BaseRingTerrain) {
3304                        BaseRingTerrain ring = (BaseRingTerrain) plugin;
3305                        SectorEntityToken atCenter = ring.getRingParams().relatedEntity;
3306                        
3307                        float centerRadius = 0f;
3308                        if (atCenter != null) centerRadius = atCenter.getRadius();
3309                        float ringMiddle = ring.getRingParams().middleRadius;
3310                        float ringMin = ring.getRingParams().middleRadius - ring.getRingParams().bandWidthInEngine / 2f;
3311                        float ringMax = ring.getRingParams().middleRadius + ring.getRingParams().bandWidthInEngine / 2f;
3312                        
3313                        float min = Math.max(centerRadius, ringMin);
3314                        orbitRadius = min + (ringMax - min) * (0.1f + 0.8f * genRandom.nextFloat());
3315                        orbitAngle = genRandom.nextFloat() * 360f;
3316                        found = true;
3317                }
3318                
3319                if (!found) {
3320                        orbitRadius = 100f + 100f * genRandom.nextFloat();
3321                        orbitAngle = 360f * genRandom.nextFloat();
3322                }
3323                
3324                EntityLocation eLoc = new EntityLocation();
3325                eLoc.type = LocationType.OUTER_SYSTEM;
3326                if (forceLoc != null) {
3327                        eLoc.location = forceLoc;
3328                } else {
3329                        if (orbitPeriod <= 0f) {
3330                                orbitPeriod = orbitRadius / (5f + 5f * genRandom.nextFloat());
3331                        }
3332                        eLoc.orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(orbitFocus, 
3333                                        orbitAngle, orbitRadius, orbitPeriod);
3334                }
3335
3336                return eLoc;
3337        }

3482                return marinesRequired;
3483        }

3540        public static int getAdjustedMarinesRequired(int marinesRequired) {
3541                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
3542                float support = Misc.getFleetwideTotalMod(playerFleet, Stats.FLEET_GROUND_SUPPORT, 0f);
3543                StatBonus stat = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PLANETARY_OPERATIONS_MOD);
3544                
3545                
3546                int min = 0;
3547                int max = 0;
3548                for (int i = 1; i < marinesRequired * 2; i *= 2) {
3549                        float currSupport = (int) Math.round(Math.min(support, i));
3550                        float strength = i + currSupport;
3551                        strength = stat.computeEffective(strength);
3552                        if (strength >= marinesRequired) {
3553                                min = i / 2;
3554                                max = i;
3555                                break;
3556                        }
3557                }
3558                if (max > 0) {
3559                        int iter = Math.max(1, (max - min) / 100);
3560                        
3561                        for (int i = min; i <= max; i += iter) {
3562                                float currSupport = (int) Math.min(support, i);
3563                                float strength = i + currSupport;
3564                                strength = stat.computeEffective(strength);
3565                                if (strength >= marinesRequired) {
3566                                        marinesRequired = (int) Math.round(strength);
3567                                        break;
3568                                }
3569                        }
3570                }
3571                
3572                //if (true) return marinesRequired;
3573                
3574                int base = 10;
3575                if (marinesRequired > 100) base = 50;
3576                if (marinesRequired > 500) base = 100;
3577                if (marinesRequired > 1000) base = 250;
3578                if (marinesRequired > 2000) base = 500;
3579                if (marinesRequired > 5000) base = 1000;
3580                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
3581                        if (marinesRequired <= (i + 1) * base) {
3582                                marinesRequired = (i + 1) * base;
3583                                break;
3584                        }
3585                }
3586                marinesRequired = getRoundNumber(marinesRequired);
3587                return marinesRequired;
3588        }
